reading: The channel is ordinary content addressing, executed in two steps the output probes couldn't separate. The program's central irony is now mechanized: the tutor never SHOWS its work (sub1 at chance) because the readout reports hop-2 — but the work IS there in hop-1 attention (45%). Stepping protocols (DECOMP-1) added nothing because they re-ask the OUTPUT for what only the ATTENTION knows. Next (proposed, not run): ask the attention, not the output — a stepped protocol that reads hop-1 focus (argmax query-pass attention as the explicit mid) instead of hop-1 output, then subqueries it. If that composes where DECOMP-1 didn't, the whole decomposition program flips from FAIL to PASS with the same weights.
